dse_runs.notes: Spec high_precision: strict accuracy (max_abs_err <= 2^-20) at >= 50 MSPS. Selection rule is min luts_plus_ffs, so favor designs near the accuracy boundary with small area; pipelined families may be needed for throughput.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

l2.reason: the spec has no system scenario: nothing to re-select

l3: not verified in this campaign: no recorded L3 row; a fresh exhaustive run (W=23) is too heavy for a live campaign
l4: no recorded synthesis for this design (L4 is not run live in campaigns)
final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **high_precision** was taken down the full fidelity ladder: L1 used the entire 400-evaluation budget via the structured DSE graph (refine → refine → stop), which converged on a single feasible, non-dominated design — `pipelined_m` with data_width=23, n_iter=22, m=6 (luts_plus_ffs=2324, power_index=4.37, 59.9 MSPS, max_abs_err 9.39e-07 ≈ 2^-20.02, satisfying both constraints). L2 system simulation confirmed the selection (contract latency 6 cycles, one input/cycle; DDS SFDR 141.9 dBc, SNR 128.9 dB). L3/L4/L5 found no recorded RTL-verification or synthesis measurements for this exact design (fresh W=23 verification too heavy for a live campaign; L4 not run live), so back_annotate had no measured data to compare and flagged no winner change — no reexplore was needed. The spec was finalized on the pipelined_m design with its L1 estimates standing.
